stores.title: Stores or collections
stores.description: Shopify store URLs or domains (https://www.allbirds.com, allbirds.com) for the whole catalog, or collection URLs (https://www.gymshark.com/collections/all) for one collection.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max products per store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Upper limit per store or collection after filtering.

oneRowPer.title: One row per
oneRowPer.description: 'product' returns one item per product with a nested variants array. 'variant' returns one item per variant with the product fields repeated.

titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Keep products whose title contains any of these (case-insensitive). Empty keeps all.

productTypes.title: Product types
productTypes.description: Keep products whose product type equals any of these (case-insensitive). Empty keeps all.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.description: Keep products whose vendor equals any of these (case-insensitive). Empty keeps all.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Keep products that carry any of these tags (case-insensitive). Empty keeps all.

inStockOnly.title: In stock only
inStockOnly.description: Keep only products with at least one available variant. In variant mode, unavailable variants are dropped too.

updatedAfter.title: Updated on or after
updatedAfter.description: ISO date. Keeps products whose updated_at is on or after this date. Use it to find new or changed products.

includeDescription.title: Include description text
includeDescription.description: Adds the plain-text product description (from body_html) to each item.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Read each store's robots.txt first and skip the store if the products.json feed is disallowed.

concurrency.title: Stores in parallel
concurrency.description: How many stores are read at the same time. Pages of one store are always read one after another with a pause.
